headline: Thirteen bosses and a Sapphiron wipe, on a night decided by three moments

mvp.headline: the most damage on Anub'Rekhan, Maexxna and the Horsemen, no boss deaths
why: First on Anub'Rekhan (127k, parse 96), Maexxna (94k) and the Four Horsemen (143k, parse 95)

also.text: the most healing on Thaddius, Gothik, the Horsemen, Heigan and Sapphiron (296k)
soaked 49 of Patchwerk's 61 Hateful Strikes with nobody dying
25 Life Drains removed on Sapphiron, the most, with Eldoren 24 and Drikkle 23

overview: 13 of 15. Anub'Rekhan through Gluth went smoothly: six bosses, one death, every kill at or under the usual time. Sapphiron ended in a wipe at 22% and Kel'Thuzad wasn't pulled.

Three moments decided the rest. On the Unholy weapons after Razuvious, a second pack reached the raid while the next one was being pulled, and the raid wiped (36 deaths). Noth ran 20 seconds longer than usual, into a second curse wave, and the curses that weren't removed exploded right as he died (31 deaths in all). And Heigan's fast dance took 28 people at once from 1:36.

The Noth explosions also took most of the raid's world buffs with them: 24 had Rallying Cry at Noth, 6 at Heigan and 2 at Loatheb and Sapphiron. Unbuffed, Sapphiron became a 7½ minute fight on 42% of the usual raid damage, and healing ran out after about five minutes.
Razuvious and Gothik had no world buffs on anyone, the usual sign of buffs stored in a Chronoboon, which is also why the trash wipe in between didn't cost them.

wipes.title: Sapphiron, pull 1 (Sapphiron at 22%)
wipes.whatHappened: Two raiders died to Sapphiron's melee in the first five seconds and two to the first Frost Breath at 1:07. After that it was a long fight: raid DPS 5.9k against about 14k on a usual kill, with Frost Aura, Life Drain, Chill and Icebolt taking people one at a time until healing gave out from 5:23.
wipes.likelyCause: No world buffs: two of the 40 had Rallying Cry. Without them the damage wasn't there for a kill before the raid's mana and health ran out.
evidence: Raid DPS 5.9k against 14k on a usual kill (42%)
41 deaths: Frost Aura 15, Life Drain 8, Chill 7, Icebolt 6
Life Drain healed Sapphiron for 218k, against 56k on a usual kill, because the fight ran twice as long
2 of 40 with Rallying Cry at the pull
wipes.avoid: Pull Sapphiron with buffs, and let the tanks get a few seconds of threat before melee starts.
